title: Capacity reservation decay and utilization sampler
author: Lina Cortez
release_notes: Adds a decay-based reservation policy and a lightweight utilization sampler to improve burst fairness and reduce over-provisioning. No customer-facing API changes.
description: Motivation: Dedicated fleets currently hold burst reservations indefinitely which leads to long-tail over-provisioning when tenants go quiet. This PR implements a conservative exponential decay for reservation weights plus a low-overhead utilization sampler that feeds short-window P50/P95 signals into the autoscaler to reclaim idle burst capacity while preserving short-term guarantees. Components: reservation-decay-controller (deterministic loop for tests), util-sampler (tenant-level P50/P95, sampled at configurable frequency), soft-fallback grace tokens (short window to avoid QoS cliffs). Config: per-tenant decay factor, sampler frequency, grace window, and a feature flag for immediate rollback. Rollout: canary 10% (2d) -> 50% (3d) -> full after monitoring; immediate disable via feature flag or set decay factor=1.0. Migration: no DB schema changes. Metrics added: redwood.reservation.decayed_tokens, redwood.util.sample.p50, redwood.util.sample.p95. Related: ENG-2486 design doc and SUP-4112 tenant investigation.
commits: add reservation decay controller; add util sampler and telemetry export; wire reservation weight into autoscaler decision path; add unit tests and integration harness; feature flag and canary configs; flake fixes
review_comments: Marty Zhang: Nice incremental approach. Two asks: add a test for backoff when util sampling reports zero traffic for long windows and document expected signal noise; please also confirm metrics cardinality guardrails.

Asha Patel: Can we decouple sampler frequency from agent heartbeat? Some agents have coarser heartbeats and we should avoid aliasing.
Lina Cortez: Sampler uses its own ticker by default; a config flag sync_sampler_with_heartbeat enables alignment. Documented choices in config file.

Lina Cortez: Increased tolerance and switched to deterministic clock in tests. Re-ran CI.
Marty Zhang: Approved after requested changes.
